audit.notes: The new chapter blocks comprehensively cover all scientifically useful content present in the old draft. Specifically: Block 1 covers the fundamental physics of chromatic dispersion and wavelength-dependent transfer functions (Old Para 1). Block 2 details performance degradation under broadband illumination, including specific quantitative results (53%, 60% accuracy for single/two-layer networks) and fabrication constraints (Old Para 2 & Old Para 5). Block 3 addresses mitigation strategies like multi-layer thin films, dual-scale nanostructures, and hardware-in-the-loop optimization (Old Para 3). Block 4 explains wavelength multiplexing for multi-task learning (Old Para 4). Block 5 covers polarization and OAM multiplexing (Old Para 5). Block 6 discusses training paradigms and complex-valued transmission coefficient optimization (Old Para 6). Block 8 synthesizes system-level trade-offs and applications (Old Para 6). No unique scientific mechanisms, comparisons, or quantified results from the old draft are missing.
